name: Hunyuan3D mesh from a picture
summary: Turns one picture of an object into a 3D mesh (GLB) with the Hunyuan3D 2 model server running on this computer; optionally textured.
when_to_use: Someone attaches a picture of a single object and asks for a 3D model, mesh, GLB or asset of it — for Blender, a game, printing.
when_not_to_use: Pictures of whole scenes or several objects, anything without a picture, or 2D edits like shadows and backgrounds.

texture.description: also paint a texture (slower; the server must be started with textures on)

octree_resolution.description: mesh detail; 256 is quick, 384–512 is finer and slower

guidance.description: how closely to follow the picture

seed.description: a fixed seed to repeat a result
